S1:14.text: The male, whoſe flesh of his prepuc shal not be circumciſed, that ſoule shalbe deſtroied out of his people becauſe he hath broken my couenant.

S1:16.text: And I wil bleſſe her, and of her I wil giue thee a ſonne, whom I wil bleſſe, and he shalbe into nations, and kings of peoples shal ſpring of him.

S1:18.text: And he ſaid to God I would that Iſmael may liue before thee.

S1:20.text: Concerning Iſmael alſo I haue heard thee. behold, I wil bleſſe him, and encreaſe, and multiplie him exceedingly: twelue dukes shal he beget, and I wil make him into a great nation.

S1:21.text: But my couenant I wil eſtabliſh with :: Iſaac, whom Sara shal bring forth to thee at this time an other yeare.

S1:24.text: Abraham was nyntie and nyne yeares old, when he circumciſed the flesh of his prepuce.

S1:26.text: The ſelfſame day was Abraham circumciſed and Iſmael his ſonne.

S3:12.text: An infant of :: eight daies shalbe circumciſed among you, al malekind in your generations aſwel the homebred shal be circumciſed, as the bought ſeruant of whoſoeuer he is, not of your ſtocke:

S3:14.text: The male, whoſe flesh of his prepuce shal not be circumciſed, that ſoule shalbe deſtroied out of his people becauſe he hath broken my couenant.

S3:16.text: And I wil bleſſe her, and of her I wil giue thee a ſonne, whom I wil bleſſe, and he shalbe into nations, and kings of peoples shal ſpring of him.

S3:18.text: And he ſaid to God I would that Iſmael may liue before thee.

S3:20.text: Concerning Iſmael alſo I haue heard thee. behold, I wil bleſſe him, and encreaſe, and multiplie him exceedingly: twelue dukes shal he beget, and I wil make him into a great nation.

S3:21.text: But my couenant I wil eſtabliſh with :: Iſaac, whom Sara shal bring forth to thee at this time an other yeare.

S3:23.text: And Abraham tooke Iſmael his ſonne, and al the homebred of his houſe: and al whom he had bought, al the males of al the men of his houſe: and he circumciſed the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very ſame day, as God had commanded him.

S3:24.text: Abraham was nyntie and nyne yeares old, when he circumciſed the flesh of his preuce.

S3:25.text: And Iſmael his ſonne was ful thirtene yeares old at the time of his circumciſion.

S3:26.text: The ſelfſame day was Abraham circumciſed and Iſmael his ſonne.

S3:27.text: And al the men of his houſe, as wel the home-bred, as the bought ſeruantes and ſtrangers were circumciſed togeather.

S6:13.text: and my couenant ſhal be in your fleſh for a perpetual couenant.

S6:16.text: And I wil bleſſe her, and of her I wil giue thee a ſonne, whom I wil bleſſe, and he ſhal be into Nations, and Kings of peoples that ſpring of him.

S6:17.text: Abraham fel vpon his face, and laughed ſaying in his hart: Shal troweſt thou to him that is an hundred yeare old a ſonne be borne and Sara that is nyntic yeares old ſhal ſhe beare?

S6:18.text: And he ſaid to God: I would that Iſmael may liue before thee.

S6:2.text: And I wil make my couenant between me and thee and I wil multiplie thee exceedingly.

S6:4.text: And God ſaid to him: I am, and my couenant is with thee, and thou ſhalt be a father of manie Naions.

S6:5.text: Neither that thy name be called any more Abram but thou ſhalt be called Abraham: becauſe a father of many Nations I haue made thee.

S6:6.text: And I wil make thee encreaſe exceedingly, and I wil make thee into Nations, and Kings ſhal come forth of thee.

S6:7.text: And I will eſtabliſh my couenant between me and thee, and between thy ſeed after thee in their generations by a perpetual couenant to be thy God, and thy ſeeds after thee.

S6:8.text: And I wil giue to thee, and to thy ſeed the land of thy peregrination, al the land of Chanaan for a perpetual poſſeſſion, and I will be their God.

S9:3.text: Abram fel flat on his face.

S9:4.text: And God ſaid to him: I am, and my couenant is with thee, & thou shalt be a father of manie nations.

S9:5.text: Neyther ſhal thy name be called any more Abram but thou shalt be called Abraham: becauſe a father of many nations I haue made thee.

S9:6.text: And I wil make thee encreaſe exceedingly, and I wil make thee into nations, and kinges shal come forth of thee.

S9:7.text: And I wil eſtablish my couenant betwen me and thee, and betwen thy ſeede after thee in their generations by a perpetual couenant to be thy God, and thy ſedes after thee.
